basic_info.description: Exceptional 4-Unit Investment Opportunity - Fully Tenant Occupied. Don't miss this rare opportunity to own a fully tenant-occupied 4-unit building in a desirable location. This classic property features a spacious 3-bedroom flat and three 1-bedroom apartments, offering a strong and diverse rental mix ideal for seasoned investors or 1031 exchange buyers.  The building includes a huge bonus attic with potential for future expansion or added income (buyer to verify), a 1-car garage, and recent capital improvements including a brand-new roof and fresh exterior paint, providing peace of mind and long-term value. With stable tenants in place and well-maintained units, this is a turnkey asset with solid income and upside potential. A smart addition to any investment portfolioschedule your showing today!
